description: This file is a shell test script for the git HTTP backend content length handling. It contains tests verifying that the server correctly respects and processes the CONTENT_LENGTH header, including edge cases like overflow, empty values, and compressed data handling.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Verifies the HTTP response status, checking for fatal errors and confirming the expected status code.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up and executes a test HTTP environment with specified handler type and request body.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Returns a string representing a size greater than the maximum of ssize_t to test overflow handling.
